name: Chili's Guiltless Grill Sirloin (6 oz Plain, Avocado & Rice)
whyItWorks: 100% USDA Choice 6 oz sirloin steak seared plain, served with steamed white Mexican rice and fresh avocado slices. Clean, lean protein and healthy fats without heavy chili seasonings.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: '6 oz Sirloin plain—NO seasoning salt, NO garlic butter, grilled with salt only.' Swap corn salsa for plain white rice.
